data.body: [operator-attested] Fix (a) MERGED: Gerrit change 1761 landed on main as a0fc8d43556 ('llm: memo-served repeats are not loop evidence'). Vote evidence: LLM-Review +1 on PS2 (which added the parametrized per-site streak-reset test covering all 5 record_executed sites and proved mutant-kill on the truncated-fallback site); Verified +1 after a recheck — the single prior CI ERROR was the pre-existing fixture flake in tests/unit/test_authorship_batched_ticket_map_7084.py (a module this change does not touch), now tracked and instrumented under bug innovative-dandruffy-deer (ee68-5ff4-fa75-4788, forensics change 1769). Submit succeeded (GET /a/changes/1761/ status=MERGED), which requires both votes green and no unresolved comments. make lint + make typecheck clean at push; CI re-proves both. 21 tests in test_agent_call_memo_nudge.py green; 10/10 manual mutants killed. Fix (b) (tri-state evidence banking at search exhaustion) is being filed as a discovered_from follow-up ticket.
